Apophenia Total Capture User Guide

What the app records, how authorization works, what stays local, and how to export for people and machines.

Apophenia is a personal Android and Garmin black box for reconstructing the circumstances around a timestamped event. It can be maximum invasive when everything is deliberately authorized and armed. That is the capability ceiling, not the default.

The privacy bargain: no account, analytics SDK, automatic cloud sync, or background uploader. Data stays local until an export is built, verified, previewed, and deliberately routed.

Capture the moment

Choose how invasive the session should be

TOTAL_EVIDENCE and presets arm named capture gates. They do not grant OS permissions, accept screen-record consent, start OBD/UAS/RF sessions, or open an export route.

What stays local

Ordinary evidence and derived metrics live in SQLite. Tier 2 contents and retained AV are encrypted with device-local keys. Raw media is bounded and expires on its retention schedule unless an event is marked keep forever. Purge receipts remain after media is scrubbed.

Analysis boundaries

  • Group dense rows by capture_id.
  • Exclude phase=POST from predictors.
  • Keep control windows identifiable.
  • Preserve multiple-comparisons correction.
  • Correlation is not causation.
  • A refuted preregistration is a useful result.

Validation boundary: emulator and simulator evidence proves software behavior only, not physical sensors, AV hardware, radios, adapters, vehicles, aircraft, SDRs, watches, field performance, or flight performance.
